name: Can accessible modifications enhance the resale value of my home?

mainEntity.name: Can accessible modifications enhance the resale value of my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessible modifications can enhance the resale value of your home, particularly in areas with an aging population or where multi-generational living is common. While highly specialized modifications might appeal to a smaller buyer pool, universal design elements like zero-threshold showers, wider doorways, and reinforced walls for grab bars are increasingly sought after. These features can make a home more functional and attractive to a broader range of buyers looking for long-term usability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessible modifications can enhance home resale value, especially universal design elements like zero-threshold showers, appealing to a broader range of buyers and aging populations.
